items.reply: I retain TP: GroupPermissionsV2.java:121–125 performs a separate permission evaluation for each configured Groups resource, with a fresh decision cache per evaluation. The global-view guard and restriction to permissioned groups narrow the affected requests but do not bound this repeated work. V1 has the same inefficiency, but this PR adds and wires a new V2 implementation with different resource lookup logic; this is not merely moved or re-indented code. Repeated full policy evaluations on user searches and counts constitute a meaningful scaling problem that batching could reduce.
